summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce interim clinical trial results to be presented at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting. The press release details ongoing Phase 1/2a studies for its radiopharmaceutical programs in melanoma, neuroendocrine tumors, and FAP-expressing solid tumors. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine clinical update.
